english.ui_the_draft_is_saving_try_again_shortly: The draft is saving. Try again shortly.

backtranslations.ui_the_draft_is_saving_try_again_shortly: AN Paint is automatically saving the image now. Wait, try again.

functional_rationale: Explicit application actor, incomplete stem with da and now describe an active current process, not successful completion, merely not-yet-saved state, or inability to save. Automatic manner narrows it to the actual autosaving guard.

The image names the editable visible working result in this status, not a newly coined general draft noun or a promise all history will be saved. Wait+retry refers to the blocked action before it executes; it gives no exact duration or success guarantee.

sources.binding: hdu explicitly belongs to type12. That pattern geminates the second radical for the incomplete and prefixes i- for third singular masculine. Footnote17 explicitly maps tense/geminate ḍ to ṭṭ, yielding authored iḥṭṭu, not guessed ittḥḍu or mechanical ḍḍ. The manual licenses da/ar/la with nonfuture incomplete. Current now adverb disambiguates ongoing from habitual reading.
Confirms this manual covers Moroccan Amazigh forms and organizes verbs by explicit conjugation types, represented by model paradigms. Does not itself attest the proposed saving sentence.

sources.binding: Own digital-save sense of hdu, automatic manner, wait imperative, exact try-again imperative, and current-time adverb. Combining that digital sense with the independently sourced incomplete paradigm is authored, not a directly attested full software sentence.
